<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 100.0524295) as the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral mass is ≈100.052 Da. The formula C₅H₈O₂ gives an exact monoisotopic mass of 100.0524 Da, matching the observed value within experimental error. This formula satisfies integer valence (DBE = 2) and fits the required CxHyOzX format.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
